newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Britain's Halcrow to modernise Moldovan airport.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Halcrow to modernise Moldovan airport.

text.p: British building consultant Halcrow will modernise Chisinau airport to international standards under a $10-million international tender it won last week, a Moldovan official said on Monday.
Stepan Zagnitco, Chisinau airport director, told Reuters the tender had been organised by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
Moldovan officials say the work, for which $1.5 million will be invested by the Moldovan government, could be started in spring next year and completed in summer 1998.

In the first eight months of this year passenger turnover through the airport was about 200,000 people, or just one-fifth of its levels a few years ago. Planes take off for 15 airports in Western and Eastern Europe and another 10 in the Commonwealth of Independent States.
